name: Cloud SIEM - Failed Records Details (parsing or mapping issue)

search.queryText:
_index=sec_record_failure AND objectType=FailedRecord
| json "reason" nodrop
| first(metadata_sourceMessageId) as metadata_sourceMessageId, count as Total by metadata_sourceCategory, metadata_vendor, metadata_orgId, metadata_product, metadata_deviceEventId, reason

| order by Total
